notes.notes: [p]I've added a Riot shield to the game in this patch. It is a nice change to the game as it adds variety to the game when you run out of ammo. Here is the list of items for this patch:[/p][list][*][p]Riot shield was added. This allows you to hold a shield and fire a gun or use the crowbar. The crowbar in this mode is an instant kill. [/p][/*][*][p]fixed collision issue at the base causing you to be able to walk through a wall in the player house.[/p][/*][*][p]added a load last save from the death menu. [/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Update version 1.0.2
notes.notes:
I've fixed a few bugs this week and added a few things.

- fixed audio slider not going all the way down.

- Fire bombs now explode on contact with zombies and can be bounced on the ground.

- changed settings menu, it now has 3 tabs one for graphics, gameplay and sound.

- graphics menu has lots of different settings you can toggle on and off. This will improve performance on lower end machines. 

- FSR 2.2 is working as intended.  

- end credits can now be skipped by pressing escape.

You can suggest new features and report bugs on the discussion forums.

notes.title: update version 1.0.1
notes.notes:
I spent the weekend working on minor bugs that people have found. Here is the list of changes I've done this weekend:
- added clearer instructions on the activate radio
- pressing shift while not moving doesn't cause the camera to shake.
- added mouse invert button in the settings menu.
- fixed tutorial for throwing bombs to be clearer.
- added large exit sign to the exit zone.
- fixed audio continually triggering on start.
- fixed melee tutorial to delete after use.

notes.title: Update version 0.8
notes.notes:
This is the last update before release. I've been working on bug fixes and polishing.  here is a list of items I fixed this week:

- added extra health to boss zombies
- fixed escape button on pause menu
- polished and balanced missions
- general balancing.
- added end credits
- added sound for vehicle repair mission
- animated large windmills
- fixed health issue where health pickups will add to much health.
- fixed camera showing rifle during cut scenes
-added sound to firebomb pickups.
- added sound to ammo creation.
- balanced starting area and added more smaller enemy spawners.
- added sound to supply pick up.
- fixed new storage unit area collision
- fixed ammo crafting types not correct
- fixed gun not aiming correctly
- added smoke to missions
- added camera sway when idle
- added camera sway to run
- fixed zombies getting stuck on care piles.
-added explanation on how to throw fire bombs.
- updated instructions on the pause menu.
- turned down screaming zombie sound.

notes.title: Beta update version 0.6
notes.notes:
Bug fixes, balancing, polish are the main focuses for this update. As I move towards full release of the game the focus will be on bug fixes. Here is the list of items that made it into the patch:
- fixed ammo spawning issue causing all ammo to spawn.
- updated text font
- fix throwing zombie death animation
- fixed weapon textures 
- added ADS to all weapons.
- added weapon sway while idle and firing
- added new storage unit are to explore
- added new zombie spawner for better balancing
- adding loading screen 
- added melee weapon sounds
- added fire bomb pick up sound.
